items.quote: He sought God during the days of Zechariah, who instructed him in the fear of God.
items.contrast: Uzziah, the person instructed, versus Amaziah, who is mentioned only as Uzziah’s father and comparison.
items.reason: The continuing subject is Uzziah, while Zechariah instructs “him,” so the key correctly identifies Uzziah as the recipient. Resolving the pronoun against the nearby mention of Amaziah is a meaningful reference distinction. However, “the instructor” is an avoidable generic stand-in; naming Zechariah would make the question clearer.
